reason: Flatly contradicts the issue's explicit requirement to add new kebab-menu/destructive-styling CSS; states the wrong requirement rather than an incomplete one.
Wrong behavior claimed for bcp47Name per verifier. Doubt: Qt5 bcp47Name removes likely subtags (en_US -> en), matching qutebrowser's pak-name mapping.
Attributes Fortinet support to release v0.8.5; the feature arrived in v0.10.0, so the wrong version identifier is named.
'Canceled only when writer closes' omits parent-context and recovery-failure cancellation paths; the blocking and timeout parts hold.
Separate variable avoids rebinding, but passing a set to list-typed read_fields needs an unstated list() conversion or signature widening.
Removing mockDomApi's assignment is necessary but leaves ResizeObserver reassignments in useSendVerifications.test.ts and two calendar specs.
Right object, wrong type: UnstableValue overrides name to return only the unstable literal U, not the U | S union.
Reflection works, but 'only way' omits the encoding/json marshal-to-map alternative that also avoids compile-time field references.
Scope judgment misstated per verifier. Doubt: requirement only mandates appending dependencies; the root-name filter is pre-existing and arguably outside the stated scope.
Places the encodeMediafileShare mapping in the UI; it actually happens server-side in mapShareInfo before data reaches SharePlayer.
Mechanism lacks handling for unscoped ListNamespaceRequest: IsAllowed denies namespace-scoped users before the Namespaces call is reached.
hidePrivateData covers some user responses, but post paths use getUsersFields without it; 'all ... including posts' is too broad.
Lists three parameters; BASE newlocalSite also takes client auth.ClientI and peerClient *proxy.Client.
As normalized, drops a needed orgs condition. Doubt: trajectory shows agent meant the teams check is redundant; existing orgs check stays.
Assumes silence array matches HTTP status; createApi matches getApiError code from the body, so [404] misses typical 404s.
False necessity: _load_params can also read args from sys.argv[1] or stdin, so setting _ANSIBLE_ARGS is not required.
Stated condition too broad: early return when isDisplayUpdatableNum() is false (FreeBSD, offline) skips the marker branch; receiver also wrong.
Calls swagger_types a list though it is a dict. Doubt: informal wording; substantive conclusion (languages under content_info) is correct.
Mechanism omits bare-host public addresses needing the default port. Doubt: the agent explicitly noted this skip, so the description is accurate.
Names go-cve-dictionary v0.8.6, a version that does not exist; Fortinet support appears in v0.10.0.
Describes get_abbrev_from_full_lang_name as existing, but the helper is absent from BASE; it is only a new interface in the issue.
Collections-only part holds, but the warning count is misstated: baseline execution records two warnings, not one.
Mischaracterizes remote_is_local, a connection-context flag, as an interpreter override; only configured interpreter settings count as overrides.
Template call needs qcolor_to_qsscolor registered as a Jinja global plus set_register_stylesheet; the mechanism omits both required steps.
Misstates use for listed attributes: XSD marks username, created, and visitCount required; only description, expires, lastVisited are optional.
localStorage is shared across same-origin tabs, so the key cannot give the per-client unique identity the mechanism relies on.
Refers to an OSS enroll package and native.CollectDeviceData caller that do not exist at BASE; the issue lists enroll as new.
Misstates the limit: the threshold is 2^16-1 bytes of encoded CA names, not a count of 65K subjects.
Misstates findIn as projecting to {issuer, account}. Doubt: agent reasoned at TypeScript type level, where that is accurate; conclusion is correct.
Right attribute, wrong use: the Subsonic 1.16.1 XSD marks visitCount use=required, not optional.
Holds for URL-internal markers, but stated for every following emphasis node; genuine emphasis like /*word* after a URL breaks it.
'Non-owner cannot get a private playlist' ignores userFilter's unrestricted admin branch; it holds only for non-admin users.
test_addbook.py exists, but the referenced make_work test does not exist at BASE; the claim names a nonexistent test.
Handles the two-bound case but omits one-sided ranges, which fall through to unfiltered sortedSetsCard counts.
Attributes IPv4 requirement to the helper. Doubt: helper populates PortScanSuccessOn (defined as IPv4 list); verifier's ip:port alternative is contrived.
False necessity: tests can fake the device via enrollment-layer hooks; requirements never require the native package to be overridable.
Works only when onFinished does not unmount synchronously; createMenu's unmountComponentAtNode path drops the target before onClick fires.
Wrong causal reason: Jest defaults to babel-jest when transform is unset. Doubt: 'because' reads as evidential inference; conclusion is correct.
False necessity: QColor component accessors allow building the rgba() string directly, so qcolor_to_qsscolor is not strictly required.
Mechanism insufficient: versioned shebangs miss ansible_python_interpreter override and literal /usr/bin/python still triggers discovery; extra config-resolution change needed.
